title: In situ nitrogen-doped porous carbon from waste baby diapers as a high-performance supercapacitor electrode material
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,20657-20667
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00450K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Guozhen Song, Yijun Tian, Jieni Wang, Shuqin Zhang, Haodong Hou, Chenlin Wei, Leichang Cao, Jinglai Zhang, Shicheng Zhang
This study presents a method for the synthesis of nitrogen-doped porous carbon (NAPC) from nitrogen-rich superabsorbent material (SAP) found in waste baby diapers for application as an electrode material for high-performance supercapacitors.
